concepts.title: Fungal hyphae
concepts.quote: Most multicellular fungal bodies, commonly called molds, are made up of filaments called hyphae.

concepts.title: Mycelial networks
concepts.quote: Hyphae can form a tangled network called a mycelium and form the thallus (body) of fleshy fungi.

concepts.title: Unicellular yeasts
concepts.quote: In contrast to molds, yeasts are unicellular fungi.

concepts.title: Fungal cell walls
concepts.quote: Fungal cell walls contain chitin, as opposed to the cellulose found in the cell walls of plants and many protists.

concepts.title: Membrane sterols
concepts.quote: Additionally, whereas animals have cholesterol in their cell membranes, fungal cell membranes have different sterols called ergosterols.
